name: Native DLL mod (C++ with MinHook)
loader: none, a proxy dll or an ASI loader
summary: A C++ dll for any Windows game: hooks game functions found by byte pattern. Loads by itself as version.dll, or through an injector or an ASI loader.
description: A CMake project that fetches MinHook and builds a dll with a worker thread, a console and a log file, a pattern scanner, one example hook and a clean unload. As a proxy it is named version.dll and forwards every export to the real one, so the game loads it with no injector.

options.label: Mod name
options.patternHelp: start with a letter; letters, digits, spaces, - and _ only

options.label: Author
options.patternHelp: start with a letter; letters, digits, spaces, - and _ only

options.label: Game folder
options.help: The game's folder. Used to copy the dll next to the game's exe after a build. Leave empty to copy it by hand.

choices.label: Proxy dll: named version.dll, sits next to the game's exe, no injector
Plain dll: you load it with an injector
ASI plugin: for games that have an ASI loader

options.label: Game is
options.help: A dll only loads into a game of the same bitness. Set from the game's exe when a game is picked.

options.label: Only run in this exe
options.help: The exe name without .exe. In any other process (a launcher, a crash reporter) the dll does nothing. Empty: run everywhere. For Unreal games this is the -Shipping exe in Binaries\Win64.

options.label: Console window
options.help: Opens a console that shows the log live. The log file is written either way.

options.label: Unload key
options.patternHelp: a Windows virtual key name without VK_, in capitals: END, F10, INSERT
options.help: Removes the hooks while the game runs. A Windows virtual key name without VK_.

options.label: Copy the dll into the game after each build
MinHook version
options.patternHelp: a git tag of TsudaKageyu/minhook, like v1.3.4

next: Install Visual Studio with "Desktop development with C++" (it includes CMake) and Git.
Run build.bat from a "Developer Command Prompt", or open the folder in Visual Studio.
The dll is in build\Release. The README says where it goes for the way of loading you picked.
Start the game: a console opens and a .log file appears next to the dll.
Your hook is in src\hooks.cpp: put a byte pattern of the function you want into kExamplePattern.
